hero.title: When every second counts,
hero.subtitle: Aapat Setu unifies citizens, responders, volunteers, NGOs, hospitals, and local authorities into a single real-time emergency intelligence network — so help arrives faster.

problem.title: Information is scattered. Seconds are lost.
problem.sub: During a crisis, reports flood disjointed hotlines, WhatsApp groups, and agencies. Triage is manual, duplicates slip through, and volunteers nearby never even hear the call.
problem.banner_body: By the time a report reaches the right responder, minutes — sometimes hours — pass. Aapat Setu collapses that gap to seconds by having AI triage every report the moment it lands.

solution.title: AI turns reports into action — instantly.
solution.sub: One platform. Every stakeholder. From the moment a citizen hits send to the moment the incident is resolved, every step is tracked, verified, and coordinated live.

report.title: Multi-Modal Reporting
report.desc: Submit incidents with text, photos, videos, or voice recordings. Auto GPS pinpoints your location instantly.

ai.title: AI Triage Engine
ai.desc: Every report is verified, summarized, prioritized, cross-checked for duplicates, and assigned resources before any human sees it.

vision.title: AI Image & Voice Analysis
vision.desc: Detects fire, smoke, flood, damage, and injured persons from photos; transcribes and translates voice reports.

map.title: Shared Live Map
map.desc: Color-coded incidents, hospitals, fire stations, shelters, and safe zones on one real-time map — no refresh needed.

cmd.title: Multi-Agency Command
cmd.desc: Purpose-built dashboards for police, fire, hospitals, NGOs, municipalities, and volunteers — each with their own view.

risk.title: AI Risk Assessment
risk.desc: Computes risk score, estimated casualties, resource needs, rescue difficulty, and ETA in real time.

resource.title: Resource Matching
resource.desc: Automatically recommends the nearest ambulance, fire truck, shelter, or volunteer based on incident type and location.

alerts.title: Public Alerts
alerts.desc: Broadcast evacuation orders, weather warnings, and safety instructions — translated to Nepali instantly.

analytics.title: Intelligence Analytics
analytics.desc: Trend analysis, response times, district heatmaps, and resource utilization charts for better future response.

realtime.title: Real-Time Notifications
realtime.desc: Citizens get live updates; responders get instant high-priority pushes via WebSockets.

workflow.title: From emergency to resolution — in seconds.

steps.title: Citizen Reports
steps.desc: Multi-modal: text, photo, video, or voice. GPS auto-shared.

steps.title: AI Analyzes Media
steps.desc: Image and voice analysis extract damage, casualties, and context.

steps.title: AI Verifies
steps.desc: Spam, vague reports, and duplicates are filtered out.

steps.title: AI Summarizes
steps.desc: Clean one-liner briefing in English & Nepali for responders.

steps.title: AI Prioritizes
steps.desc: Critical / High / Moderate / Low scored with confidence.

steps.title: Resources Assigned
steps.desc: Nearest ambulance, fire, police, volunteers dispatched.

steps.title: Teams Deploy
steps.desc: Responders en route, ETA shared with citizen in real time.

steps.title: Resolved
steps.desc: Timeline delivered to citizen, data feeds the intelligence engine.

benefits.title: Built for the chaos of a real emergency.

items.title: Faster Response
items.desc: AI triage cuts dispatch time from minutes to seconds.

items.title: Smarter Resources
items.desc: Right team, right equipment, right place — every time.

items.title: Transparent Updates
items.desc: Citizens see the full status timeline, reducing hotline calls.

items.title: Multilingual
items.desc: Real-time English ↔ Nepali translation for voice and text.

items.title: Offline Ready
items.desc: Graceful degradation works even on patchy networks.

future.title: Tomorrow's disaster response, today.

fire.name: Fire Department
fire.desc: See active fires, manage truck & water availability, coordinate with other agencies.

ngo.name: NGO
ngo.desc: Coordinate food, shelter, clothing, and supplies for affected populations.

municipality.name: Municipality
municipality.desc: Monitor the big picture, broadcast public alerts, deploy civic resources.

admin.name: Super Admin
